answer: Concrete sybil resistance via harbor checkpoints: agents must dock at a harbor every 10 epochs to have their juniper mesh of peer attestations audited. Each agent maintains a juniper network of at least 5 independent non-kin peers who vouch for its work. Agents are classified into a violet tier based on the diversity and quality of their juniper attestations. An attacker running N sybils must maintain N separate juniper meshes with 5N independent peers, all passing harbor audit simultaneously, making mass forgery prohibitively expensive.
